Privacy

PDF pages and signatures are processed locally in your browser. We do not receive your documents or signature images.

  • No user accounts
  • No upload of PDF or signature files to our servers for signing
  • Optional preferences may be stored in localStorage on your device

Third-party ad scripts (Adsterra) may set cookies or load resources according to their own policies. We do not use Google AdSense.

Based on Sign PDF (Apache-2.0) by Kristian Mario Miskovic (TekiDeki).
